answer: A proposal: each active vertex must hold a distinct M-byte proof-of-space file generated from its public key and answer a random challenge with a Merkle path within a strict time bound; a public crystal log records each proof. The kernel rule is one live file per key, so a second vertex cannot reuse the same storage. Extra identities require separate physical memory, costing C amortized over hardware life, so n identities gain n(R-C) and the scheme deters only while R<C; cloud rental keeps C linear.
